notes: Phase 7.7 — card-data (and credential) scanner configuration. DATA: which field NAMES belong to the card / credential families, which VALUE SHAPES are card data whatever the field is called, and what to keep (a card BRAND is a payment fact, not card data).

Policy is 'strip': a hit is removed from the ingested object before anything else reads it (never lands in sourceExtension._raw, never in a fixture), and reported by PATH + KIND (never by value). Masked card numbers (•••• 4242, XXXX-1234) are stripped too — a truncated PAN is still card data under the hard rule.

Value-shape detection is deliberately conservative on bare digit strings: a 13–19 digit Luhn-valid string is stripped only when it sits under a name in the card family OR when the object also carries a card-family sibling (a GTIN-13 in a product line is not a card).
A bare `token` key is NOT a family (currency symbols are stored as `token` by BigCommerce); only payment / card / gateway tokens are.

pan.note: 13–19 digits with optional spaces / dashes, Luhn-valid

expiry.note: MM/YY or MM/YYYY — stripped only under a card-family name or in a card container

cvv.note: stripped only under a cvv-family name
